title: Calorimetry
description: Burn something in a sealed bomb under water and the water's rise in temperature is the heat it gave. Unlocks the Bomb Calorimeter and Thermochemical Data Cards.

puzzle.goal: Water of mass m and specific heat c warms by T kelvin. Write the heat q it took in.
puzzle.name: Sensible heat
puzzle.ask: Find q in kJ for m = @{m} kg, c = @{c} kJ/(kg·K) and T = @{T} K.
puzzle.method: The heat warms the water by an amount set by its mass and how much heat each kilogram takes per kelvin.
